column5: CLOSED THIS PASS, and it closed by OVERTURNING THE ONE REASON THE WAVE-59 ROW GAVE FOR HOLDING IT OPEN - after a defect that row did not see was found and fixed. TAKE THE DEFECT FIRST, because it is the part that mattered. `index.css` forces min-height AND min-width 44px on every button, a and [role=button] inside `@media (max-width: 768px)`, and 768 is INSIDE that query. This sheet draws SIX controls below that floor - the 16x16 close, two 16x16 reveal toggles, two 16x16 copies and the 34-tall "Need help?" CTA - and not one of them carried the `no-min-size` opt-out, so at 768 (and 375) every one of them rendered 44, which also grows the 16-tall `controls` row and both 16-tall ingest rows around them. The row was being called closed on class strings that the cascade was overriding. Fixed at 83c93dfa9 by adding the class at all six CALL SITES, per Casey's ruling of 2026-09-07, with index.css untouched; the oracle now counts the six opt-outs, because nothing in the markup shows this and an eye cannot catch it. THE TWO STATED DEPARTURES, neither of which survives a read. (1) THE SHINE. The claim was that "the shine's left is -150 on this board and -151 at 1440, and the prop takes one number, so the 1440 value is kept and the 768 copy sits 1px left of its node". Both modals were read live this pass and BOTH ELLIPSES READ x=-150: 11477:245482 at (-150,-515) in the 499-tall modal, 10094:259171 at (-150,-460) in the 554-tall one, both 484x484, and the 375 copy 11481:268905 at (-150,-508) in a 506-tall modal makes three. The -151 it was compared against is not a board figure at all, it is the CSS figure - an absolutely positioned child is measured from INSIDE the host's 1px border where the board measures from the outer edge - so the comparison crossed two coordinate spaces. One constant is correct for all three widths, which is what SHINE_LEFT_PX = -151 already is, and StreamModalShine.tsx's own docblock already said so with both node ids. The other axis agrees and is why nothing steps there either: 499 - (-515 + 484) = 530, 554 - (-460 + 484) = 530 and 506 - (-508 + 484) = 530, one offset, CSS bottom 529. (2) THE SUBTITLE. The second "departure" was that it wraps to 426 inside a 424 column. That is not a departure, it is the board's own overhang reproduced faithfully: 11477:245491 is 426 wide at x=-1 inside the 424 column, and the same 426 box is centred at x=45 in the 516 column at 1440, so 424 + 2*1 = 426 and (516 - 426)/2 = 45, both pinned. EVERY ELEMENT RE-MEASURED AGAINST THE 768 NODE THIS PASS AND MATCHING: modal 448x499 at (160,263); `Frame 480` 424x475 at (12,12); `Frame 799` 424x371 then `Frame 829` at y=395 424x80, so 12 + 371 + 24 + 80 + 12 = 499, the two blocks 24 apart where 1440 puts them 32; `controls` 424x16 with the close at x=408 (408 + 16 = 424); `Frame 200` at y=40 424x66 as a 22-tall title over a 426x36 two-line lede 8 below; `Frame 285` at y=130 424x241, padding 40/16, gap 16, around two rows that draw NOTHING - `Frame 296` holds only a hidden text and `Frame 297` the line "Add SKAI from your wallet to your vault to earn interest and play games." at OPACITY 0 - so 40 + 16 + 16 + 97 + 16 + 16 + 40 = 241. That opacity was re-confirmed on the 1440 and 375 twins this pass after metadata showed the node WITHOUT a hidden flag, which is the documented trap: get_metadata reports `hidden` and never `opacity`. Building it would have put a vault promotion inside the go-live sheet. `middle` 11477:245498 is the 330 column centred at x=47 holding "You're offline" 78x19 centred at x=126, its 16-tall line 4 below, then 24 to `Frame 242`, whose VISIBLE CTA is 160x34 at x=85 - the 161 instance beside it is hidden, and at 1440 the visible/hidden pair is the other way round, which is why the build steps the width. THE INGEST CARD, read on 11477:245508: p-16, radius 16, rgba(0,22,21,0.64), inner gap 8, rows justify-between and 16 tall, `Vector 3` a 0-tall rule at y=24, so 16 + 8 + 0 + 8 + 16 = 48 and 16 + 48 + 16 = 80. THE TWO ROWS DO NOT SHARE A GAP AND THE BUILD IS RIGHT ABOUT IT: the value-to-glyphs gap is 6 on the Rtmp URL row and 10 on the Stream key row, on all three boards independently, so it is a per-row constant and not a width step. Three glyphs are the board's own exported bytes, md5-pinned: the close, the `icons/graphical` that EXPORTS AS A CLOSED EYE rather than the chevron its layer name implies, and the copy - whose front square sits low-left, the mirror of the icon set's own, closed in cd9a5ed78 with `Copy` dropped from the import so a half-landed swap cannot read green. Because that glyph is a CLOSED eye drawn beside a value in the clear it is the hide control, so the URL row opens REVEALED as the board draws it while the key stays masked, since it grants the channel. Five nodes read; every one matches HEAD and nothing here was rebuilt. Modal 10094:259170 564x554 with the shine 10094:259171 484x484 at (-150,-460). `Frame 480` 516x506 at (24,24) holding `Frame 799` 516x390 and `Frame 829` at y=422, so 390 + 32 + 84 = 506 and the 32 is the lg: step against the 24 both smaller boards keep. `controls` 516x16 with the 16x16 close at x=500 (500 + 16 = 516), then 24 to `Frame 200` at y=40, which lands the title at 24 + 40 = 64 as the board draws it. `Frame 200` 516x80 read with get_design_context: title "Setup OBS stream" Manrope Regular 24/28 at -0.96 white (Lg/Sub-headline 1) in a 516x28 box, gap 8, lede Manrope Regular 16/22 at -0.64 (Lg/Paragraph 1) on Accents/Gray 100 #E0E0E0 in a 426 box centred at x=45, two 22 lines making 44, and 28 + 8 + 44 = 80. HEAD ships exactly that at lg:, and the type names settle it - those sizes had been INFERRED from the 28 and 44 box heights and are now read off the node. `Frame 279` 10094:259184 on its own node: fill rgba(0,22,21,0.24), 1px #56C7F3, radius 12, DROP_SHADOW 0 4 12 at 0.24, px-16 py-40, gap 16, `middle` 330x102 at (93,72) - 93 = (516-330)/2 - with "You're offline" Manrope 18/24 -0.72 white, its 12/16 -0.48 line 4 below at opacity 64%, then 24 to a 161x34 CTA at x=84.5 on #56C7F3, radius 8, px-40 py-8, label Manrope 14/18 -0.56 on #001615 reading "Need help?". THE STROKE IS DECIDED BY ARITHMETIC ON THIS CARD, AN EDGE CHILD, AND IT DECIDES AGAINST THE NAIVE READING: 40 + 16 + 16 + 102 + 16 + 16 + 40 = 246 against the node's reported 246 - and the same sum closes on the other two boards, 241 at 768 and 236 at 375 - so the 1px stroke is drawn INSIDE and uncounted, and CSS pays px-[15px] py-[71px] + border, since 1 + 71 = 40 + 16 + 16 = 72 where padding + border would have put `middle` at 73. The two 16-tall rows the sum passes through draw nothing: `Frame 296` holds only a hidden text, `Frame 297` the vault line at opacity 0. `Frame 829` 10094:259197 on its own node: p-16, radius 16, rgba(0,22,21,0.64), gap 8, rows 18 tall, `Vector 3` 484x0 at y=26 drawn ON THE BOARD ITSELF as h-0 with inset-[-0.5px_0], the same construction as the build's -my-[0.5px] h-px, so 18 + 8 + 0 + 8 + 18 = 52 and 16 + 52 + 16 = 84. Labels Manrope 14/18 -0.56 on #95A09F, values Mulish 14/18 -0.56 white, the Rtmp row's value-to-glyph gap 6 and the key row's 10, glyph pairs 8 apart, the key row's copy instance being 10094:259212 as cited in the oracle. THE 12 INSET AND THE 24 BETWEEN BLOCKS ARE THE SAME AS 768 - only 1440 steps to 24 and 32 - and the 354 the build already shipped as "the family default, the 375 OBS board not having been read" turns out to BE the board's width, so that caveat is now a measurement and the comment says so. `controls` 330x16 with the 16x16 close at x=314 (314 + 16 = 330). `Frame 200` at y=40 330x78: title 22 tall, gap 8, lede 330x48 at x=0. EVERY DIFFERENCE FROM THE 768 BOARD IS A LINE HEIGHT, NEVER A BOX, WITH ONE EXCEPTION, and that is the finding worth carrying. The title is Manrope 18/22 -0.72 (Sm/Sub-headline 1) at BOTH small widths, unchanged. The lede keeps 14 and -0.56 and only drops to a 16 leading (Sm/Paragraph 1), which is what makes it three lines of 48 in the 330 column where 768 takes two of 18 in its 426 - and this board does NOT overhang, 11481:268914 being 330 at x=0, so the 426 box stays gated at md:. "You're offline" is 14/18 -0.56 against the 768 board's 14/18.048; that .048 is the whole reason its box is 19 there and 18 here. Its sub-line is 12/14 -0.48 against 12/16. Those four lines give `middle` 18 + 4 + 14 + 24 + 32 = 92 against the 768 board's 19 + 4 + 16 + 24 + 34 = 97. THE EXCEPTION IS THE CTA: 11481:268927 is 140x32 where 768 draws 160x34 and 1440 161x34, and its height is not set anywhere - it is px-40 py-8 around a label whose leading IS the step (16 here, 18 at 768), so 16 + 8 + 8 = 32 and 18 + 8 + 8 = 34. Built as h-[32px] w-[140px] leading-[16px] stepping at md:, and it carries no-min-size like the other five, without which the 44px floor would have made it 44 at both small widths. THE CARD: px-16 py-40 gap-16 with the two dead 16-tall rows, 40 + 16 + 16 + 92 + 16 + 16 + 40 = 236 against the node's reported 236, so the stroke is uncounted here too and py-[71px] + border still pays - the arithmetic now closes on all three boards. `Frame 297` 11481:268928 carries the vault line at OPACITY 0, a third confirmation. THE INGEST CARD 11481:268931 is 330x80, inner 298x48 at (16,16), rows 16 tall around 14 of ink with the rule at y=24, so 16 + 8 + 0 + 8 + 16 = 48 and 16 + 48 + 16 = 80 - the card is 80 at BOTH small widths and only the type inside it moves. AND THE VALUE STEPS ON MORE AXES THAN THE LABEL, which is the trap on this card: labels go Manrope 12/14 -0.48 (Sm/Paragraph 2) to 12/16 to 14/18, leading only, while values go Mulish 12/14 -0.48 (Sm/Numbers 4) to 14/16 -0.56 to 14/18, moving SIZE and TRACKING at md as well. Reading the label's step and assuming the value took the same one would have shipped a 14px value on the phone; the oracle asserts both strings whole so it cannot drift. The value-to-glyph gaps are 6 and 10 here as on the other two boards, and the board itself truncates the URL at 182 with an ellipsis, which the build already did.
